mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.COURSE_ID AS courseId, c.TITLE AS title, l.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM AS regionName, c.THEME AS theme, COUNT(cd.COURSE_DAY_ID) AS dayCount, c.ACTIVE_YN AS activeYn, c.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM COURSE c LEFT JOIN LDONG l ON c.REGION = l.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD LEFT JOIN COURSE_DAY cd ON c.COURSE_ID = cd.COURSE_ID GROUP BY c.COURSE_ID, c.TITLE, l.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM, c.THEME, c.ACTIVE_YN, c.CREATED_AT ) AS tmp ORDER BY tmp.createdAt DESC

SELECT c.COURSE_ID AS courseId, c.TITLE AS title, c.SUBTITLE AS subtitle, c.DURATION AS duration, c.REGION AS region, l.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM AS regionName, c.THEME AS theme, c.TOTAL_DISTANCE AS totalDistance, c.HISTORY_YEAR AS historyYear, c.HISTORY_SUMMARY AS historySummary, c.INTRO_TITLE AS introTitle, c.INTRO_TEXT AS introText, c.HERO_IMAGE AS heroImage, c.ACTIVE_YN AS activeYn FROM COURSE c LEFT JOIN LDONG l ON c.REGION = l.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD WHERE c.COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
SELECT COURSE_DAY_ID AS courseDayId, COURSE_ID AS courseId, DAY_NO AS dayNo, DAY_TITLE AS dayTitle FROM COURSE_DAY WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId} ORDER BY DAY_NO

SELECT cp.COURSE_PLACE_ID AS coursePlaceId, cp.PLACE_ID AS placeId, tp.TITLE AS placeTitle, cp.PLACE_DESC AS placeDesc, cp.PLACE_ORDER AS placeOrder FROM COURSE_PLACE cp JOIN TOUR_PLACE tp ON cp.PLACE_ID = tp.CONTENT_ID WHERE cp.COURSE_DAY_ID = #{courseDayId} ORDER BY cp.PLACE_ORDER
SELECT TIP_CONTENT FROM COURSE_TIP WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId} ORDER BY TIP_ORDER

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, TITLE AS title, ADDR1 AS addr1, FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage FROM TOUR_PLACE WHERE FIRST_IMAGE IS NOT NULL AND FIRST_IMAGE != ''
AND (TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ADDR1 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY VIEW_COUNT DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE ( TITLE, SUBTITLE, DURATION, REGION, THEME, TOTAL_DISTANCE, HISTORY_YEAR, HISTORY_SUMMARY, INTRO_TITLE, INTRO_TEXT, HERO_IMAGE, ACTIVE_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{duration}, #{region}, #{theme}, #{totalDistance}, #{historyYear}, #{historySummary}, #{introTitle}, #{introText}, #{heroImage}, COALESCE(#{activeYn}, 'Y'), NOW() )
INSERT INTO COURSE_DAY (COURSE_ID, DAY_NO, DAY_TITLE) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{dayNo}, #{dayTitle})
INSERT INTO COURSE_PLACE (COURSE_DAY_ID, PLACE_ID, PLACE_ORDER, PLACE_DESC) VALUES (#{courseDayId}, #{placeId}, #{placeOrder}, #{placeDesc})
INSERT INTO COURSE_TIP (COURSE_ID, TIP_CONTENT, TIP_ORDER) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{tipContent}, #{tipOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE COURSE SET TITLE = #{title}, SUBTITLE = #{subtitle}, DURATION = #{duration}, REGION = #{region}, THEME = #{theme}, TOTAL_DISTANCE = #{totalDistance}, HISTORY_YEAR = #{historyYear}, HISTORY_SUMMARY = #{historySummary}, INTRO_TITLE = #{introTitle}, INTRO_TEXT = #{introText}, HERO_IMAGE = #{heroImage}, ACTIVE_YN = #{activeYn}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
UPDATE COURSE SET ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
UPDATE COURSE SET ACTIVE_YN = 'N' WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD AS lDongSignguCd, L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM AS lDongSignguNm FROM LDONG ORDER BY L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD
